headline: About
paragraphs: I'm a Software Engineer at Salesforce, Bengaluru, building backend systems for Tableau Cloud Manager. My work spans licensing infrastructure, user services, and cloud migrations — with a focus on reliability and scale.

I'm drawn to systems problems: compilers, distributed systems, and the kind of engineering where correctness really matters. Outside work, I contribute to open-source and write about engineering challenges I encounter along the way.
